A portrait in objects.
A tabletop reveals personal taste: the things we choose to
keep reflect our everyday aesthetics and the way we live.

beauty in overlooked corners of daily life, reflecting each woman's

ANOTHER
SIDE OF ME
A personal story of growing up with an eye for beauty.
A copy of VOGUE at a newsstand sparked my interest in fashion in high
school. From current trends to the visual signatures of past eras, colour,
silhouettes, makeup and imagery continue to shape my eye and inspire me.
A university photography course took me from looking to creating. Through
collaborative shoots, I explored light, composition and mood, discovering a
deeper interest in the ideas and creative direction behind fashion imagery.
Today I turn style observations, beauty trends and collected inspiration into
social posts. Each one is a way to express my taste and discover my own voice.
Personal Style · Inspiration · Expression

Short for 'inspiration', inspo captures the people, images and ideas
that spark creativity. Fashion and beauty inspo often comes as
posts or videos that suggest a look, a mood or a new perspective.
Closely associated with Instagram and Pinterest, inspo is
now shared widely across social media, often under labels
such as 'fashion inspo' and 'beauty inspo'.
I explore Instagram, Pinterest, YouTube and X, following current
trends and revisiting fashion archives. Moving between eras and
styles helps me develop my eye. I collect striking visuals and
emerging trends, then turn them into posts for Xiaohongshu.
I started this account to share fashion trends and inspiration, adding my
own reflections to develop my voice. This creative outlet has gradually
found an audience who connects with my taste and perspective.

高中时，报刊亭⾥放着的⼀本《VOGUE》打开了我对时尚的认知。⽆论是当下
的潮流，或是不同时代的独特美学印记，都令我着迷。⾊彩、轮廓、妆容与影

如今，我偶尔会通过社交媒体平台分享风格观察与美妆趋势，将收集到的灵感整

事物，也可以这样理解，“ins”就是inspire，“po”代表po⽂，inspo就
是那些可以带给⼈们关于时尚或美学启发的⽹络图⽂或视频内容。
inspo最早源于ins和Pinterest，近年随着潮流发展被更广泛的运⽤到
各⼤社交媒体平台当中，通常搭配为“fashion inspo”或“beauty
inspo”
日常⾥，我喜欢在 Instagram、Pinterest、YouTube 和 X 之间探索，
关注当下的潮流，也翻阅过往的时尚档案，在不同年代与⻛格的碰撞
中，慢慢形成⾃⼰的审美。我会将那些令我⼼动的视觉表达，以及观
察到的流⾏趋势，整理成图⽂，分享到⼩红书。
做这个账号的初衷是主要用来收集和分享⼀些有趣的各类Inspo以及
时尚趋势分享，偶尔也会夹带⼀些⼩想法，保持我的态度与表达能
⼒。这份出于兴趣的积累，也逐渐收获了⼀些共鸣与喜欢。
